title: Explain and fix the remote card cleanup that an awaited delivery missed
goal: A controlled regression shows why an awaited Telegram delivery after a remote dashboard decision left the relayed buttons, and the fix makes the awaited pass reconcile that decision without widening a timeout or weakening an assertion
acceptance: A committed deterministic regression fails before the fix for the stated mechanism and passes after it
Delivery passes never overlap and the periodic tick still skips while a pass runs
Exactly-once sends, eventual stale-button removal, retry after restart and the signed status lookup are preserved
The one-channel fixture waits for the state its assertion depends on, with no timeout widened or assertion weakened
Windows and full-suite CI pass on the PR
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures only; no model inference, private hosts or device operations
validation: test/telegram-reconcile.test.ts 'a delivery awaited after a dashboard decision is not a pass that read status before it' fails before the fix and passes after it
Channels group regressions (telegram, telegram-reconcile, one-channel, channel-state, chat-command, dashboard); full deterministic CI including Windows
Fresh-context design review before the parent is verified
escalation: Do not merely widen timeouts or weaken assertions
Keep the parent open until CI runs on main show no recurrence
